name: Calm-regime momentum (ATR-capped trend)
rationale: Low-vol-trend edge: ride established medium-term momentum ONLY while daily volatility is contained. ret_Nd>0 confirms an up-trend is already in force; the ATR ceiling (normalized true range, a fraction of price) gates entries to calm regimes, sidestepping both directionless chop and late-stage blowoff/euphoria tops where vol explodes and trends mean-revert. The bet: trends that persist quietly compound; trends that get loud are about to break.
catalyst: Persistent low-volatility uptrends (steady accumulation / orderly markup) keep grinding higher, while high-ATR spikes mark exhaustion or whipsaw that erodes trend-following P&L.
